Treasure Bags are consumable grab bag -like items obtained in Expert Mode and Master Mode as a reward for defeating bosses . The contents and appearance of Treasure Bags depend on the boss it comes from, and are opened by using either ⚷ Open / Activate while inside the inventory , or ⚒ Use / Attack when selected in the hotbar . They emit light and have a special effect around them when dropped, making them easier to spot. In multiplayer , each player that deals damage to the boss receives one Treasure Bag upon defeating it. Treasure Bags are client-side and will despawn upon exiting the world. See Notes for details.

The Fallen Star is an item that randomly falls from the sky at night and disappears at dawn (4:30 AM). They can be used to craft Mana Crystals , which permanently increase a player's mana capacity by 20 points each. They are also used in a variety of crafting recipes, and as ammunition for the Star Cannon and Super Star Shooter . Hence, Fallen Stars can be stored in ammo slots .

The Fisherman's Pocket Guide can be received as a 1/34 (2.94%) [ 1 ] chance reward for completing a fishing quest for the Angler NPC , depending on the number of completed quests and other factors (see Angler § Quest rewards for details) . The Angler will not give the player a Fisherman's Pocket Guide as a reward if they already have one in their inventory or in any of their portable storage items or loadouts . However, if the player has all of the Angler's fishing and informational accessories [ 2 ] (or their upgrades like the Angler Tackle Bag and Fish Finder ) in their inventories, this rule will be ignored. [ 1 ]
